verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs show automatic capture of chat updates via internal status pages (`/fh update` and Command Center posts), AI Scribe transcription of incident-bridge discussions/decisions, and audit logs tracking runbook/incident events, all of which feed the incident record. Retrospectives support collaborative editing and AI-drafted timelines that can be revised afterward, satisfying the 'edit or annotate' requirement. missing for 10: explicit product documentation of a unified 'incident timeline' view (as opposed to separate status page/audit log/retrospective components) and independent hands-on confirmation of editing captured timeline entries.
